"fold": true adds the closing "Plus smaller fixes and polish" line. An entry with "failed" is ignored by the page and asked again after 7 days; delete it to try sooner. Keep this file valid JSON: while it does not parse, nothing is summarized.

bullets: **Windows** — chats, searches the web, speaks and listens on Intel, AMD and ARM PCs; installs Ollama for you
**Video** — ask for a short clip and it renders on your Mac; a size ladder shows what each quality costs
**Export** — ask for an answer as a PDF, Word document, spreadsheet, slides, calendar file, CSV and more
**Removed** — Contribute and the free community image cloud
**Benchmark on this computer** — a stalled model load is stopped and the reason shown, you can skip a model, and a busy machine is flagged
**Benchmark Stop** — stops right away instead of waiting for memory to settle
**Sidebar** — Pinned and Recents can be folded up from their headings
**Waking from sleep** — lights come back white and fans return to 20%, as on a fresh idle
**Bonding** — use two connections at once, like Wi-Fi and Ethernet or a phone by USB, for networks that cap each device
**Metered connections** — phones and data-plan connections are counted and join only when your main line is nearly full
**Servers** — Auto picks the fastest; change passwords, name or address in the app; QR codes for phone VPN apps
**A cleaner main window** — Mode and Exit open in place, your ISP under your IP, Quick or Extended speed test in every mode
**Mode explainer** — what each mode does and gives up, plain summary first, then trade-offs and technical detail
**Low speed results** — the note now says it's this Mac, names a weak Wi-Fi signal, and can be hidden
**iOS profiles** — profiles for a server set up with a hostname are no longer refused
Fewer stuck states, safer password prompts and a steadier Speed card
**Speed test** — detects networks that give a burst of speed and then throttle, and reports the throttled speed as your line speed
**Speed test** — on a throttling network it no longer tries Brutal, and the result explains what the network is doing
**Speed test progress bar** — no longer jumps backwards during a run
**ConcordeGo Lite** — a short search at /lite: say where you need to be, and it finds a few good flights to get you there
**Earliest or cheapest** — Lite shows the earliest arrival and the cheapest side by side, and opens a flight in place
**More details** — each Lite flight shows the aircraft, its on-time record and more
**Anything else?** — add requests as Lite searches, such as keeping certain airports out of the trip
